artifact: source-only literal transcription; not a production data patch

source.editionNote: The private source filename identifies it as DMG_1stEd.pdf; exact printing is not additionally asserted by this transcription.

privateRenderFrames.scope: Full PDF page 75 context; all three target matrices and neighboring I.B are visible.

beforeState.source: Parent-provided pre-repair baseline already exists; this transcription does not overwrite or regenerate it.

method.visualSourceReview: Rendered original PDF page 75 at 300 dpi and inspected actual page and full-context crop pixels with view_image. Exploratory close-up renders were used only during author inspection; complete 300-dpi table-context crops are the retained review frames. All source renders/crops remain private.
method.sourceResolutionLimit: PDF page 75 contains an embedded 1160×1586 raster (~145.85×148.83 dpi). The 300/600-dpi renders are resampled from this source image and do not add source detail; the scan is below 216 dpi at the embedded-image level. Numeric cells remain visually legible in the full-table crops. The tiny I.D superscript glyphs were initially source-ambiguous to the author and are preserved as an uncertainty before independent marker-only corroboration below.
method.transcriptionRule: The source prints defender armor-class rows from −10 through 10 and attacker-level columns. Values were read from source pixels, then only transposed into the existing attack-matrices.json orientation: armorClasses 10 through −10 and one row per attacker band. No cells were generated by a formula, extrapolated, or inferred from neighboring values.
method.completeContext: Each private 300-dpi table crop contains its printed table heading, Opponent Armor Class row axis, 20-sided die score caption, all attacker-band columns, all 21 source rows, and associated missiles/footnotes. Separate 600-dpi I.D crops show the band markers and note labels.
method.ocrUse: PDF text extraction/OCR was inspected only as a locator/candidate aid and was not used to supply or validate numeric cells or marker meanings.
method.independentReviewState: Numeric cells and note application remain pending blind independent review. Independent marker-only readings are recorded separately and do not certify numeric values, crop focus, or citation suitability.

I.C has one asterisk on the Missiles line and the matching “Normal, not magical.” footnote. I.D.1 has four backstab note markers a–d; bands carry a,b,c,d,d,d. I.A has its unmarked missile range line.
No production data, source citations, classes, images, or distribution files were changed.
